changes.title: Settings, your way
changes.where: Title screen and during a run
changes.why: Adjust music and sound effects independently, with separate volume and mute controls. Enable Kids Mode before your next run for slower play, four keys, and shorter words.

improvements.why: Tap finished results to return to the title.
Browse older changes with a yellow scrollbar, clear of the keys.
New lands get a little tour, with clearer trails between stops.
Tap outside to close the list. Browse with soft bloops and a little buzz.

fixes.why: Your chosen flyer stays with you. The rocket loop ends with one blast-off.
Best Score fades away so the heading stays clear.

changes.title: What's cooking?
changes.why: Tap the little steamer to explore what is new. A few tiny demos, a few new tricks!

changes.title: Hello, rainbow!
changes.why: A rainbow ripples out from your pickup. Your power-up has arrived!

fixes.why: Partner pairs count as one stage enemy.
Fixed an issue where Star Path could not finish after all 20 stars were collected.

changes.title: Off we go!
changes.why: Pick a land and your dumpling walks there. A little trip before the action!

changes.title: Star chaser
changes.why: Each win adds a little more zip, keeping the chase fresh.

fixes.why: Your flyer stays gone after blasting off.

changes.title: Surprise delivery
changes.why: Catch a surprise: a power-up or a cheeky debuff. Every pickup keeps you guessing.

changes.title: Nice disguise!
changes.why: Incognito hides faces. Monochrome hides colors. A fresh twist for your eyes!

changes.title: Sneaky slime
changes.why: The boss hides its prompt in slime, so you can see when it is safe to hit.

fixes.why: See your surprise before it takes off.
A louder beat for the big showdown.
Sound effects stay ready to play.

changes.title: Better together
changes.why: Press both pals together to pop the pair. A little teamwork for your thumbs.
